params.body:
A dealer clicked the transport truck on a customer order and nothing happened (Portal mail:19).

**Cause.** `Order::vehicle()` loads the order's vehicle `withTrashed`, so the truck shows on an order whose car the garage deleted after the sale. `TransportController::ownVehicle` did not include trashed vehicles, so the window answered 404, and `modal.get` ignored a failed load. On production the garage of the report had two orders, both on a deleted car. This is not rare: of 224 orders in the 90 days to 15 October 2026, 80 are on a deleted car, 54 deleted within 14 days of the order.

**Change.**
- `ownVehicle` accepts the garage's own deleted vehicles; a deleted car of another garage stays 404. Every transport route on a vehicle (window, conditions, request) goes through it.
- `modal.get` shows a message (the server's, or `ui.modal_load_failed` in five languages via a meta tag in the layout) when a window does not load, for every window in the application.
- R S4-10.17 says so.

Tests: new `TransportForADeletedOwnVehicleTest` (404 on main, passes here: conditions asked, accepted, request stored; another garage's deleted car refused). Full PHP suite and vitest green.

Closes #1017
params.title: Transport truck opens for a car the garage deleted after the sale
